entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You won't be able to defeat me unless[n]you actually fight with lethal intent. Now,[n]show me your true skills.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Make sure that you come at me with[n]the intent to kill me this time.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It seems I've bested you—that is, if you[n]were truly giving that fight your all.
